customers.evidence: We believe our first responsibility is to the patients, doctors and nurses, to mothers and fathers and all others who use our products and services.

employees.evidence: We are responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We must provide an inclusive work environment where each person must be considered as an individual.

dei.evidence: We must provide an inclusive work environment where each person must be considered as an individual. We must respect their diversity and dignity and recognize their merit.

environment.evidence: protecting the environment and natural resources.

community.evidence: We are responsible to the communities in which we live and work and to the world community as well.

shareholders.evidence: Our final responsibility is to our stockholders. Business must make a sound profit.

integrity.evidence: We must provide highly capable leaders and their actions must be just and ethical.

safety.evidence: working conditions clean, orderly and safe.

innovation.evidence: We must experiment with new ideas. Research must be carried on, innovative programs developed, investments made for the future and mistakes paid for.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, credo-based framing with absolute 'must' language throughout, and first-person plural 'we'. Stakeholders are ordered explicitly: patients and customers first, then employees, communities, and stockholders last. The page cites its 1943 origin and calls the Credo a recipe for business success, linking values to profit.
